subject: Sentinel renewal: capacity acceleration validation + tailored commitment
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Singh <maya@sentinel.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Nov 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Sentinel renewal: capacity acceleration validation + tailored commitment

Hi Maya —

Congrats on the successful Q3 rollout — happy to see latency trending down on your end. Per our renewal conversation last week you flagged two priorities: 1) guarantee capacity during the holiday peak window and 2) a tight validation that our performance at 2x token volume matches the requirements your engineers called out.

Proposed next steps from our side:
- Run a focused side-by-side throughput validation on Wednesday (11/22) using your production traces (we can use the sample you sent).
- If the validation meets the SLA thresholds we’ll put a short-term capacity acceleration commitment for Dec–Jan to ensure headroom.
- Draft a one-page amendment with a 90-day accelerated pool and a follow-on committed uplift (numbers below).

Can you confirm:
- Who from your infra team will own the trace supply? (Oliver was mentioned in the renewal call)
- Any blackout dates we should avoid for the test?

I’ve looped Marissa for legal/contract alignment and Ben for throughput engineering so we can move quickly. I attached a small export template to speed up the ingest.

Thanks —
Ava Chen
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0138

Attachments: sentinel_kpi_export.csv (CSV: sample request/metrics template)
From: Maya Singh <maya@sentinel.ai>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Oliver Reed <oliver.reed@procureco.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Nov 2028 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Sentinel renewal: capacity acceleration validation + tailored commitment

Thanks Ava — appreciate the pragmatic plan. A few notes from our side: 

- Oliver (copied) will own trace delivery. He’s tied up on Thursday but can deliver by EOD Friday.
- We are also actively evaluating a competing provider that offered a guaranteed 50% price improvement if they can match response times. Decision window is narrow — CFO pushed to finish procurement by 11/30.
- Critical ask: the side-by-side must include a burst scenario (2k concurrent streams for 90s) — our production peak looks like that. If you can validate under the same profile, we have internal buy-in to keep Redwood.

Two quick questions:
1) Can Redwood commit to the accelerated pool size for Dec–Jan on a conditional DocuSign amendment (we need contractual assurance prior to procurement close)?
2) Are there any configuration changes required on our side to run the burst test?

Oliver — can you confirm when traces will be available?

Best,
Maya
Head of ML Ops, Sentinel.ai
maya@sentinel.ai
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Singh <maya@sentinel.ai>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Connor Obrien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Nov 2028 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Sentinel renewal: capacity acceleration validation + tailored commitment

Maya / team —

Short answer: yes, we can validate the 2k concurrent-burst profile with no infra changes on your side beyond providing the trace and the concurrent-client script (we can provide the script). A few technical specifics up-front: 

- Test profile: 2,000 concurrent streams, 90s sustained, sequence length distribution as per column 'seq_len' in your CSV.
- Environment: we’ll run side-by-side on identical instance types (g5x2 equivalent); results will include p50/p95/p99 latency, token/sec, and GPU utilization traces.
- Failure threshold: p99 latency > 750ms or error rate > 0.5% flags a fail.

Conditional commitment approach we recommend:
1) Redwood issues a short amendment (DocuSign powerform) that guarantees a dedicated accelerated pool (spec list) from Dec 1 to Jan 31, conditional on the validation passing.
2) If validation passes we will activate the pool the day after results are published and issue a credit equal to 10% of the December usage should we fail to meet the agreed p99 SLA on two separate test windows during the month.
3) If validation fails, Redwood will provide a 30% one-time credit and a prioritized engineering remediation plan.

I attached an initial side-by-side report template (PDF) that we’ll fill in after tests. Also included is the client script stub we run for concurrency.

- Attachments included: side_by_side_throughput.pdf (template)

Connor — can you own the test orchestration with Sentinel once we have traces?

Ben
Senior Performance Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Singh <maya@sentinel.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Connor Obrien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Nov 2028 16:42:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Sentinel renewal: capacity acceleration validation + tailored commitment

Maya —

Thanks — appreciate the urgency. Summary and next steps (single-action plan):

1) Oliver to drop traces + concurrency config into the Drive folder by Friday 11/24 EOD. (Oliver: note the Drive link above).
2) Redwood will run the side-by-side on 11/25 morning PST and publish the filled template within 6 hours of test completion. Ben/Connor will own run + report.
3) We will issue the conditional amendment via DocuSign immediately after Redwood confirms pass criteria; Sentinel signs to lock the accelerated pool. The amendment will be explicit that activation occurs after publication of passing results.
4) If we pass, Redwood activates the Dec–Jan pool and we convert to the longer-term committed uplift conversation before the renewal signature.

I’ve drafted the amendment and uploaded the redlines (redlines_v2.docx) to the Drive; Marissa will shepherd the DocuSign flow. If you want the amendment phrased differently (e.g., an SLA-backed rebate instead of a pool guarantee), call that out now.

We understand procurement timing is tight — we’ll prioritize the run and aim to get you a contractual instrument you can take to your CFO before 11/30.

Thanks,
Ava
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
